_note: SOP structured after publicly known disaster-response procedure patterns (MCD/NDRF/DDMA style escalation), not a copy of any specific government document.
title: Structural Collapse Response SOP v2.1
trigger_conditions: Building/structure collapse reported in a residential or mixed-use area
Possible entrapment or casualties at the site
auto_approved_actions: Deploy Fire & Rescue Unit to the site for structural assessment
Deploy Rapid Action Team for area cordon and crowd control
Send alert to nearby responder units
requires_human_approval: Deploying Medical/Ambulance Unit to a facility or route flagged as access-blocked
escalation_rule: If the hospital-access or rescue task remains unresolved 15+ minutes after assignment, escalate to the District Control Room (on-call) and open an approval request if further spend, NDRF deployment, or blocked-route medical deployment is required.
